boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-admission places and activities for a low-key, under-21-safe hang around UIUC and Champaign County.

cards.title: Browse Krannert Art Museum
cards.subtitle: 500 E. Peabody Dr., Champaign
cards.notes: Meet at the Kinkead Pavilion entrance, choose one gallery to explore together, then compare the artwork that held your attention.
cards.short_summary: A self-paced art-gallery hang with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Krannert Art Museum states that it is always free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Plan a Visit | Krannert Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Friday and Saturday; the museum lists holiday closures. Check the visit page before going.

cards.title: Explore the Spurlock Museum
cards.subtitle: 600 S. Gregory St., Urbana
cards.notes: Start in the galleries, use the exhibit QR codes for context, and pause in the central spaces to compare one object each.
cards.short_summary: A museum visit centered on global cultures and material history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Champaign County Museums Network lists Spurlock Museum with free admission and a suggested donation.
cards.source_title: Visit Our Member Museums | Champaign County Museums Network
cards.access_notes: Check the museum visit page for current gallery hours; groups of 10 or more are encouraged to book ahead.

cards.title: Walk the Illinois Arboretum
cards.subtitle: 1800 S. Lincoln Ave., Urbana
cards.notes: Use the paths for an unhurried loop, take a bench break, and keep to marked routes while you look over gardens and natural areas.
cards.short_summary: A daylight garden-and-path walk south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum is open daily to the public from dawn to dusk, and admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk. Parking may be metered; walking, cycling, or transit avoids that separate cost.

cards.title: See the Plant Biology Conservatory
cards.subtitle: Plant Sciences Laboratory, 1201 S. Dorner Dr., Urbana
cards.notes: Plan a weekday stop to walk through the conservatory and plant collections; move slowly and leave plants and displays undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: An indoor plant-collection visit on the south side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Extension states the Plant Biology Greenhouses are free and open to the public on weekdays.
cards.access_notes: The current facility page lists greenhouse operating hours as 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Monday–Friday, excluding holidays.

cards.title: Settle In at The Urbana Free Library
cards.subtitle: 210 W. Green St., Urbana
cards.notes: Pick a floor or reading area, browse a topic together, and use the visit as a quiet catch-up without needing to buy anything.
cards.short_summary: A public-library hang for browsing, reading, or conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Urbana Free Library says it was established as free and open to the public and continues that public-service mandate.
cards.access_notes: Use the library's current-hours page before visiting; borrowing materials may require a library card, but visiting does not require admission.

cards.title: Visit the Museum of the Grand Prairie
cards.subtitle: Lake of the Woods Forest Preserve, Mahomet
cards.notes: Make the short county outing, choose an exhibit to investigate, and use the galleries as a starting point for a shared local-history conversation.
cards.short_summary: A free Champaign County history museum inside Lake of the Woods.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum says it is always free because it is a facility of the tax-supported Champaign County Forest Preserve District.
cards.source_title: Plan a Visit | Museum of the Grand Prairie
cards.access_notes: The museum publishes seasonal hours and annual January–February closure information; check before making the trip.

cards.entity_name: Champaign County History Museum at the Historic Cattle Bank
cards.title: Browse the Cattle Bank Museum
cards.subtitle: 102 E. University Ave., downtown Champaign
cards.notes: Explore the restored Cattle Bank and its local-history exhibits, then take a few minutes to discuss a detail that connects to campus or town.
cards.short_summary: A downtown local-history museum in a restored historic building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Champaign County Museums Network lists the museum as free admission with a suggested $3 donation.
cards.source_title: Champaign County History Museum | Champaign County Museums Network
cards.access_notes: The museum's own site lists Wednesday–Saturday public hours; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Browse Government Information Services
cards.subtitle: Main Library, 1408 W. Gregory Dr., Urbana
cards.notes: Bring a question about a civic topic, look through government publications together, and ask staff for help locating a useful source.
cards.short_summary: A Main Library research stop with public access to government information.
cards.evidence_claim: University Library says government depository libraries provide public access and reference help free of charge.
cards.source_title: Public Services | Government Information Services | University Library
cards.access_notes: Government information is available to affiliated and non-affiliated users; verify Main Library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Join Yoga in the Park
cards.subtitle: Garden Pavilion, Meadowbrook Park, Urbana
cards.notes: Bring a mat or use a loaner when available, arrive a few minutes early, and join the guided outdoor session at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal guided yoga session held outdoors at Meadowbrook Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Urbana Park District describes Yoga in the Park as free, for all ages and abilities, with no registration requirement.
cards.source_title: FREE Yoga in the Park begins June 1 at Meadowbrook Park
cards.access_notes: This is seasonal programming. Confirm the current schedule and weather status with Urbana Park District before leaving.

cards.title: Try a Free Tech Workshop
cards.subtitle: Champaign Public Library, 200 W. Green St., Champaign
cards.notes: Choose a beginner-friendly workshop, bring a question about a device or account, and learn alongside someone you came with.
cards.short_summary: Public-library technology workshops for practical, low-pressure learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Champaign Public Library describes its Getting Started with Tech workshops as free, friendly, and open to everyone.
cards.access_notes: Workshop topics and times vary. Check the library's event schedule and any registration instructions before attending.
